schema.text: How many adults (aged 18 or older), including yourself, live in your home?
schema.help: Count everyone who lives with you, including flatmates or a live-in carer.

en.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: How many adults (aged 18 or older), including yourself, live in your home?
en.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: Count everyone who lives with you, including flatmates or a live-in carer.

it.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Quante persone adulte (dai 18 anni in su), te compreso/a, vivono nella tua abitazione?
it.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: Conta tutte le persone che vivono con te, compresi coinquilini o un/una badante convivente.

fr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Combien d’adultes (18 ans ou plus), vous compris(e), vivent dans votre logement ?
fr.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: Comptez toutes les personnes qui vivent avec vous, y compris les colocataires ou une aide à domicile qui habite chez vous.

de.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Wie viele Erwachsene (ab 18 Jahren), Sie selbst eingeschlossen, leben in Ihrer Wohnung?
de.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: Zählen Sie alle Personen, die mit Ihnen wohnen, auch Mitbewohnerinnen und Mitbewohner oder eine im Haushalt lebende Pflegekraft.

tr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Siz dahil, evinizde kaç yetişkin (18 yaş ve üzeri) yaşıyor?
tr.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: Ev arkadaşları veya sizinle yaşayan bir bakıcı dahil, sizinle yaşayan herkesi sayın.

fa.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: با احتساب خودتان، چند بزرگسال (۱۸ سال و بالاتر) در خانه شما زندگی می‌کنند؟
fa.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: همه کسانی را که با شما زندگی می‌کنند بشمارید، از جمله هم‌خانه‌ها یا مراقبی که با شما زندگی می‌کند.

hu.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Önnel együtt hány felnőtt (18 éves vagy idősebb) él a lakásában?
hu.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: Számoljon bele mindenkit, aki Önnel él, a lakótársakat vagy a bentlakó gondozót is.

ar.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: كم عدد البالغين (18 عامًا فأكثر)، بمن فيهم أنت، الذين يعيشون في منزلك؟
ar.#Count everyone who lives with you, incl: احسب كل من يعيش معك، بمن فيهم شركاء السكن أو مقدّم الرعاية المقيم.
